To Whom It May Concern:

Pursuant to the Freedom of Information Act, I hereby request the following records:

- Contracts, task orders, statements of work, performance work statements, and position descriptions for the position titled "CENTCOM Liaison to NTC-CD," or any other position serving as a U.S. Central Command liaison to the National Targeting Center, between January 1, 2024 and the date of search, from the CBP Office of Field Operations, the National Targeting Center, and the CBP Office of Acquisition, including the following words/phrases "CENTCOM Liaison," "NTC-CD," "Central Command," "USCENTCOM," "Robert Utz"
- Memoranda of understanding, memoranda of agreement, interagency agreements, and reimbursable agreements between CBP and U.S. Central Command or the Department of Defense (Department of War) concerning liaison officers or detailed personnel assigned to the National Targeting Center or to CBP offices in Brussels, Belgium, between January 1, 2022 and the date of search, from the National Targeting Center, the CBP Office of International Affairs, and the CBP Office of Chief Counsel, including the following words/phrases "CENTCOM," "USCENTCOM," "Central Command," "NTC-CD," "Brussels," "liaison"
- Records sufficient to show the full name, mission, and organizational placement of the National Targeting Center component abbreviated "NTC-CD," including organizational charts and mission statements, between January 1, 2024 and the date of search, from the National Targeting Center
- Emails sent or received by Robert Utz (associates.cbp.dhs.gov account) between January 1, 2025 and the date of search including the following words/phrases "CENTCOM," "USCENTCOM," "Central Command," "NTC-CD," "EUCOM," "NATO," "targeting"
- Travel authorizations, country clearance requests, and duty-station assignment records for Robert Utz relating to Brussels, Belgium, between January 1, 2024 and the date of search, from the CBP Office of International Affairs and the National Targeting Center, including the following words/phrases "Utz," "Brussels," "Belgium," "CENTCOM"

If any part of these documents are exempt from disclosure, please be sure to review and release all reasonably segregable nonexempt portions of responsive documents, as the FOIA requires.

I request that I be properly classified as a media requester. I am an assistant editor at Reason Magazine who has written numerous articles on topics of public interest, and I am requesting these documents in an editorial capacity. Please contact me if you have any questions about my media status.

The requested documents will be made available to the general public, and this request is not being made for commercial purposes.

In the event that there are fees, I would be grateful if you would inform me of the total charges in advance of fulfilling my request. I would prefer the request filled electronically, by e-mail attachment if available or CD-ROM if not.

Thank you in advance for your anticipated cooperation in this matter. I look forward to receiving your response to this request within 20 business days, as the statute requires.

Sincerely,

Matthew Petti

To Whom It May Concern:

Pursuant to the Freedom of Information Act, I hereby request the following records:

- All records concerning the Homeland Security Investigations (HSI) Combatant Command Program, including liaison and analyst assignments to U.S. Special Operations Command, U.S. Southern Command, U.S. Africa Command, U.S. European Command, and U.S. Central Command, between January 1, 2019 and the date of the search, from HSI's Office of International Operations and the HSI Attaché and Liaison Program, including the following words/phrases "combatant command," "liaison," "SOCOM," "SOUTHCOM," "AFRICOM," "EUCOM," "CENTCOM," "MacDill"
- All records concerning the duties, activities, and reporting of HSI personnel assigned to combatant commands, including liaison activity reports, weekly and monthly activity reports, taskings exchanged between HSI and the combatant commands, briefing materials, and country clearance and TDY travel records, between January 1, 2019 and the date of the search, from HSI's Office of International Operations, including the following words/phrases "Tampa SOCOM," "Miami SOUTHCOM," "Stuttgart," "activity report," "country clearance"
- All position descriptions, memoranda of agreement or understanding between ICE and the Department of Defense concerning combatant command liaison positions, and funding documents for such positions, between January 1, 2019 and the date of the search, from HSI's Office of International Operations and the ICE Office of the Chief Financial Officer, including the following words/phrases "combatant command," "liaison," "memorandum of agreement," "detail"
- All records concerning the coordination between HSI liaison personnel assigned to U.S. Central Command and the ICE National Targeting Center, between January 1, 2019 and the date of the search, from HSI's Office of International Operations and the National Targeting Center, including the following words/phrases "CENTCOM," "National Targeting Center," "NTC-CD"

If any part of these documents are exempt from disclosure, please be sure to review and release all reasonably segregable nonexempt portions of responsive documents, as the FOIA requires. If the names of individual personnel are withheld under Exemptions 6 or 7(C), please release the individuals' position titles, duty stations, and the total number of personnel assigned to each combatant command.

I request that I be properly classified as a media requester. I am an assistant editor at Reason Magazine who has written numerous articles on topics of public interest, and I am requesting these documents in an editorial capacity. Please contact me if you have any questions about my media status.

The requested documents will be made available to the general public, and this request is not being made for commercial purposes.

In the event that there are fees, I would be grateful if you would inform me of the total charges in advance of fulfilling my request. I would prefer the request filled electronically, by e-mail attachment if available or CD-ROM if not.

Thank you in advance for your anticipated cooperation in this matter. I look forward to receiving your response to this request within 20 business days, as the statute requires.

Sincerely,

Matthew Petti

communications.subject: Freedom of Information Act Request: ICE embassy budget
communications.communication:
To Whom It May Concern:

Pursuant to the Freedom of Information Act, I hereby request the following records:

- All budget, financial, and cost records concerning the operations of ICE and Homeland Security Investigations (HSI) personnel assigned to U.S. embassies, consulates, and overseas attaché offices, between October 1, 2019 and the date of the search, from the ICE Office of International Operations, the ICE Office of the Chief Financial Officer, and the HSI Attaché and Liaison Program, including the following words/phrases "attaché," "attaché office," "post operating costs," "ICASS," "International Cooperative Administrative Support Services," "overseas"
- All annual and per-post cost records for each ICE/HSI overseas post, including personnel costs (salaries, locality pay, post differentials, overseas housing allowances, per diem), International Cooperative Administrative Support Services (ICASS) cost bills and invoices from the Department of State, lease and rent payments, security costs, and travel and transportation of household effects, between October 1, 2019 and the date of the search, from the ICE Office of the Chief Financial Officer and the ICE Office of International Operations, including the following words/phrases "ICASS," "housing allowance," "post differential," "cost bill"
- All records concerning the number of ICE and HSI personnel assigned to U.S. embassies and consulates overseas by post and by fiscal year, between October 1, 2019 and the date of the search, from the ICE Office of International Operations, including the following words/phrases "attaché," "overseas post," "staffing," "assigned"

If any part of these documents are exempt from disclosure, please be sure to review and release all reasonably segregable nonexempt portions of responsive documents, as the FOIA requires. If the names of individual personnel are withheld under Exemptions 6 or 7(C), please release the individuals' position titles, duty stations, and the total number of personnel assigned to each post.

I request that I be properly classified as a media requester. I am an assistant editor at Reason Magazine who has written numerous articles on topics of public interest, and I am requesting these documents in an editorial capacity. Please contact me if you have any questions about my media status.

The requested documents will be made available to the general public, and this request is not being made for commercial purposes.

In the event that there are fees, I would be grateful if you would inform me of the total charges in advance of fulfilling my request. I would prefer the request filled electronically, by e-mail attachment if available or CD-ROM if not.

Thank you in advance for your anticipated cooperation in this matter. I look forward to receiving your response to this request within 20 business days, as the statute requires.

Sincerely,

Matthew Petti
